unlisted_practices: Using LLM-simulated therapist-patient sessions as a pre-clinical experimental paradigm to test psychotherapy process manipulations
Using blinded LLM raters with repeated ratings plus human coder subsample to assess motivational interviewing treatment integrity

screen.reason: This is a proof-of-concept simulation study using LLMs to simulate both patient and therapist in motivational interviewing sessions for in silico psychotherapy research; it does not test a health care deployment practice or guardrail.
